title: Zesty Lazy Greek Boudin Blanc Tiropita
description: A lazy Sunday Greek dish featuring boudin blanc, with a resinous and glassy jelly texture, made Jain-friendly by using plant-based ingredients and served in a tiropita form.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
In a bowl, mix together the boudin blanc, ferment jang, olive oil, lemon juice, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Place a quarter of the boudin blanc mixture onto the center of each phyllo dough piece.
Fold the phyllo dough into a triangle and press the edges together to seal the tiropita.
Brush the tops of the tiropita with a little olive oil.
Place the tiropita on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes.
Serve the tiropita warm and enjoy.
